note: White Mountain NF campground on US-302 about two miles from Twin Mountain, at the Zealand Road turn. Open and partly wooded sites in one loop between the highway and the Ammonoosuc River; the river-side sites sit above a wooded bank. Small RVs fit but the loop road is tight (no posted max length). --Claude
summary: FS page and map read: $24, extra vehicle $6, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing), mid-May to mid-October, vault toilets, potable water, 11 sites, 50% Senior/Access discount. All confirmed. Note de-duplicated. Waterfront riverfront -> creekside proposed: the Ammonoosuc is ~15-22 m wide here, with a wooded bank band. Pin is across the river.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside proposed (not --AWH; stored evidence is only 'assessed in commit 32ea296'). The FS says 'open and partially wooded camping along the Ammonoosuc River', and its map puts sites 1-6 on the river side of the loop. On Esri the channel at the campground is about 15-22 m wide including gravel bars (riverfront needs ~30 m+, curation doc). The mown loop lawn ends 25-35 m from the channel, with a 15-20 m wooded bank strip between and a path at the SW corner down to a gravel bar by the Zealand Rd bridge. That fits creekside (an easy walk down within ~50 m; a wooded slope is allowed for creekside) but not riverfront. If the wooded strip is read as a screen, it becomes not waterfront.

PIN 44.26457,-71.50060 (the FS page's own coordinates) is in the forest WEST of the Ammonoosuc, across the river from the campground. The loop lawn is between US-302 and the river bend east of the Zealand Rd bridge, about 44.2648,-71.4996 (~85 m away). Under 250 m, but the pin is on the wrong bank.
Phone 603-536-6100 and website confirmed (the FS page lists the Supervisor's Office number).
Stored hookups none and showers/dump false left as stored: the FS page lists only vault toilets and water.
